如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    终于，林逸进了石门，踏进了大殿，在大殿的正前方有一个很大的石碑映入了林逸的眼帘，上面用篆体书写了几句话：
月圆之夜，石门顿开，有缘之人，方可入内。
天明之前，切记离开，五年之后，石门再开。
林逸小的时候和林老头学过篆体，所以很轻易的就认出了石碑上面所写的八句话。
林逸看完了这八句话之后，就开始琢磨起这些话的意思来。
月圆之夜，这很好理解了，今天不就正好是月圆之夜么？
而石门顿开，指的肯定是这朱红色的石门了！不过有缘之人是什么意思？
难道自己就是那个有缘之人，才可以入内的？
这让林逸觉得很奇幻，也很不解。
自己好像没有什么特殊吧？
孤儿一个，被林老头子收养，浑浑噩噩的到了八岁，没觉得自己有什么异于常人的地方啊？
至少和林老头比，自己就没什么比林老头强的地方。
不过，既然自己进来了，那就姑且算是那个有缘之人吧！
而天明之前，就更好理解了，就是在太阳出来，亮天之前的意思，切记离开是指，让自己天明之前必须离开？
恩，从字面上理解应该是这个意思了。
但是后面那个五年之后石门再开是什么意思？
难不成他说的是，自己如果没在天明之前离开这里，石门就会自动关闭，下次再次开启就是五年之后了？
林逸想到这里不由得打了个寒噤，亏了自己看得懂篆体，不然的话，傻了吧唧的在这里呆上一宿，到时候洞门一关，自己岂不是完蛋大吉了？
别说五年了，就是五天不吃不喝的，也够呛啊？
现在既然知道了这个洞里还有这个规矩，那么林逸就赶在天明之前出来应该就没有什么问题了！

想到这里，林逸的心稍稍放了下来。
这时候，林逸才近距离的观看着大殿里面的情形，原来，在大殿的四壁上都镶嵌满了夜明珠，所以这里面才光明如昼。
只要稍微识货一点的人就可以看出来，这四壁上镶嵌的夜明珠每一颗都价值连城，如果拿出一颗到外面的市场去拍卖，那也是价值连城了。
不过林逸从小在大山里长大，对这些金银珠宝并不是很感冒，虽然觉得很奇妙很好看，但也没认为这些东西拿出去后能卖出什么大价格来。
关键问题是，这大山里，他卖给谁去啊？
最有钱的就是村头的王寡妇了，家里是开小吃部和小卖店的，一年能剩下一千多块呢！
不过再有钱，谁会拿钱买这些不实际的东西？
在林逸看来，有钱还不如买两块大肥肉吃呢，那多香啊，这夜明珠中看不中用，也不能吃。
所以林逸没有把目光过多的停留在大殿的奢华装饰上，而是四下里在大殿里探查起来。
按照平时自己之类的地方就会得到一些奇遇，比如得到一本盖世武功的秘籍！
想到这里，林逸心里就是一阵激动，这要是找到一本盖世武功的秘籍，自己就不用受老头子的压榨了！
等自己练成以后，老头子就不敢打自己了！
大殿很大，但是却很空旷，除了四面这些金碧辉煌的装饰之外，就是大殿中央的两个建筑物了。
其中一个就是林逸进来之后第一眼看到的那块石碑，而在石碑的后面，却是一个高台！
高台很像是古代那种祭祀用的神台，又好像是一个门派中，放置重要东西的地方。
总之，看样子年代已经十分久远了，至少在现代是不会出现类似的建筑了。
林逸也没多想，三步两步的就跑上了高台，在高台的最顶端，看到了一个古香古色的小木盒。
林逸顿时心中一阵激荡，这不会就是什么藏经盒之类的东西吧？
林逸小心翼翼的将盒子拿了起来，将盒子拿到手后，立刻从高台上跳了下去，将身形隐匿起来。
因为林逸听说这种远古的建筑上经常暗藏机关，自己动了人家的宝贝，万一有什么机关开启，那就操蛋了。

不过，林逸等了半天，也不见得有什么特殊的事情发生，才暗暗的松了一口气。
林逸并不急于而现在，林逸决定用仅有的一些时间再对这个洞穴进行一下探查。
绕过高台，林逸却是惊奇的发现，在高台的后面，居然还有一道石门，而在石门的旁边，另有一块小的石碑！

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast track. Finally, Lin Yi entered the stone gate and stepped into the main hall. In front of the main hall, there was a large stone tablet that caught Lin Yi's eyes. There were a few words written in seal script on it:
On a full moon night, the stone gate opens and only those who are destined can enter.
Remember to leave before dawn. Five years later, the stone gate will open again.
Lin Yi learned seal script from Old Man Lin when he was young, so he easily recognized the eight sentences written on the stone tablet.
After Lin Yi read these eight sentences, he began to ponder the meaning of these words.
It’s a full moon night. This is easy to understand. Isn’t today a full moon night?
And the stone door suddenly opened, it must be referring to this vermilion stone door! But what does it mean to be a destined person?
Could it be that he is the one who is destined to enter?
This made Lin Yi feel very strange and puzzled.
You don't seem to be anything special, right?
An orphan, he was adopted by Mr. Lin. At the age of eight, he didn't feel that he was any different from ordinary people?
At least compared to Old Man Lin, I have nothing better than Old Man Lin.
However, since I have come in, let’s just consider him the destined person!
And before dawn, it is easier to understand. It means before the sun comes out and the sky breaks. Remember to leave. Does it mean that you must leave before dawn?
Well, that’s what it means literally.
But what does it mean that the stone gate will be reopened five years later?
Could it be that what he was saying was that if he did not leave here before dawn, the stone gate would automatically close and the next time it would open again would be five years later?
Lin Yi couldn't help but shuddered when he thought of this. Fortunately, he could understand the seal script. Otherwise, he would have been stupid and stayed here all night. When the cave door was closed, wouldn't he be doomed?
Not to mention five years, even five days without food or water is enough, right?
Now that we know that there are rules in this cave, there should be no problem for Lin Yi to come out before dawn!
Thinking of this, Lin Yi felt relieved a little.
At this time, Lin Yicai took a close look at the situation inside the hall. It turned out that the four walls of the hall were inlaid with luminous pearls, so the inside was as bright as day.
Anyone with a little knowledge of goods can see that each of the luminous pearls inlaid on the four walls is priceless. If one were to be auctioned in the market outside, it would also be priceless.
However, Lin Yi grew up in the mountains and was not very interested in these gold and silver jewelry. Although he thought they were strange and beautiful, he didn't think they would fetch a high price after being taken out.
The key question is, who will he sell to in this big mountain?
The richest person is Widow Wang from the village head. Her family runs a snack bar and a small shop, and she can have more than 1,000 yuan left over a year!
But no matter how rich you are, who would use the money to buy these impractical things?
In Lin Yi's opinion, if you have money, you might as well buy two big pieces of fat meat to eat. It tastes so good. This night pearl is of no use and cannot be eaten.
Therefore, Lin Yi did not focus too much on the luxurious decoration of the main hall, but went around to explore the main hall.
Normally, you will get some adventures by yourself, such as getting a secret book of unparalleled martial arts!
Thinking of this, Lin Yi felt excited. If he found a secret book of unparalleled martial arts, he would not have to be squeezed by the old man!
After he has mastered it, the old man will not dare to hit himself!
The main hall is large, but very empty. Apart from the splendid decorations on all sides, there are two buildings in the center of the main hall.
One of them was the stone tablet that Lin Yi saw at first sight after coming in. But behind the stone tablet, there was a high platform!
The high platform is very similar to the ancient sacrificesThe altar used seems to be a place where important things are placed in a sect.
In short, it seems that it is very old, at least in modern times there will be no similar buildings.
Lin Yi didn't think much, and ran up to the high platform in three or two steps. At the top of the high platform, he saw an antique small wooden box.
Lin Yi suddenly felt excited. Could this be some kind of scripture storage box?
Lin Yi carefully picked up the box. After taking the box, he immediately jumped off the high platform and hid his figure.
Because Lin Yi heard that such ancient buildings often have hidden mechanisms, and if he tampered with other people's treasures, he would be screwed if any of the mechanisms were opened.
However, Lin Yi waited for a long time, but nothing special happened, so he secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
Lin Yi was not in a hurry. Now, Lin Yi decided to use the little time he had to explore the cave again.
After walking around the high platform, Lin Yi was surprised to find that behind the high platform, there was actually a stone gate, and next to the stone gate, there was a small stone tablet!
